user_intent_category.description: The primary goal or intent of the user's prompt, categorized into classes like Information Seeking, Creative Writing, Code Generation/Debugging, Text Editing/Transformation, or Reasoning.

topic_domain.description: The thematic domain of the conversation, such as STEM, Humanities, Business, Daily Life, or Language Learning.

user_constraints.description: The type of explicit constraints or formatting rules requested by the user, categorized into classes like Formatting/Structure, Length/Word Count, Tone/Style, or No Constraints.

assistant_fulfillment_strategy.description: The primary response strategy or format delivered by the assistant, categorized into classes like Direct Answer, Step-by-Step Explanation, Code Block, Refusal, or Clarification.
